messages.subject: flexible indexing/transpose syntax
parts:
I see the error of my ways in the parser.
I didn't account for unbounded application of
indexing and suffixing for expressions. It's
a bit of a pain to fix, so I'm going to take it
on tomorrow. I'll send e-mail back to the list
when it's working as advertised in the manual :-).

- Bob
